objective: Prevent the production strict external AGI claim CLI from lowering the repository's two-independent-group quorum.
findings: The strict user-facing claim CLI now fails closed when asked for fewer than two independent evaluator groups per criterion.
The rejection happens before the CLI reads the evidence ledger or verifier registry.
The hardening preserves the strict independent evidence gate rather than creating new claim evidence.
claim_boundary: This is internal development evidence. It documents gate hardening but cannot satisfy independent evaluator quorum, production isolation, or any AGI capability criterion by itself.
